messages:
zoe: Heads-up — customer acct_908 signed up from US, completed email + phone verification, used carrier billing (T‑Mobile) on Android during checkout, but never received the 100 free-trial credits. IP and locale look US. Can payments team confirm if carrier billing blocks autogrant?
payments-bot: auto-check: payment_method=carrier_billing, pm_status=confirmed, provider=carrier, autogrant=false, ring=payments; risk_score=12 (low). No autogrant rule match: pm_type_unsupported_for_autogrant.
kai: Thanks Zoe — can you paste the signup trace id and any webhook IDs? Also confirm whether user retried with a card afterwards.
zoe: trace_id: trace_20260315_71f; webhook_id: wh_9902. User did NOT add a card after initial carrier flow, tried opening app again but no credits. Repro steps I followed: 1) Fresh device profile (Android emulator) 2) Choose "Carrier billing" 3) Complete carrier auth 4) Redirect back to app -> account created. No grant.
zoe: Repro curl log from the webhook callback we logged: ```POST /webhooks/payments HTTP/1.1
Host: api.redwood-inference.com
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "event": "payment_confirmed",
  "account_id": "acct_908",
  "payment_method": { "type": "carrier_billing", "provider": "tmobile", "id": "pm_cb_77" },
  "risk": { "score": 12, "flags": [] }
}```
maria: Payments-eng here — carrier billing intentionally excluded from autogrant because our auto-grant rules require a BIN or tokenizable PM for reliable chargeback signal. Carrier flows return provider tokens without BIN metadata, so autogrant=false by design. That's why payments-bot flagged pm_type_unsupported_for_autogrant. We can manual-grant after quick checks.
zoe: Understood. Customer is confused because they completed verification. Any quick manual process?
maria: Yes — if risk_score < 30 and account age < 2 minutes we can do a one-off grant. Steps: 1) confirm webhook shows payment_confirmed 2) verify no active fraud flags 3) run `POST /internal/manual_grant {account_id, amount, reason, reviewer}`. Example curl we used: ```curl -X POST "https://internal.redwood/v1/manual_grant" -H "Authorization: Bearer RESTRICTED" -d '{"account_id":"acct_908","amount":100,"reason":"carrier-billing-autogrant-override","reviewer":"maria"}'```
support-ops: I ran the quick checks, risk_score=12, no fraud flags, account created 45s ago. Executed manual grant and emailed user confirmation. Credits set to 100.
payments-bot: event recorded: grant_event id=evt_4321, method=manual, reviewer=support-ops.
zoe: Thanks all — relaying to customer. Could we add a brief note in billing FAQ about carrier billing not auto-granting credits? Customer confusion is a repeatable hit. :speech_balloon:
maria: Agree, filing a docs PR after standup.
